# Will Cook's websites

This host's root page lists Will Cook's websites and films. Each website is its own project with its own source and its own agent entry where one exists.

- [Plectis Mathematics](https://wcook04.github.io/practical-formal-verification/map/): Eight Erdős problems I researched with AI, with the papers, computer-checked proofs of partial results and the approaches that failed. Agent entry: https://wcook04.github.io/practical-formal-verification/llms.txt
- [Lean Exposition](https://wcook04.github.io/lean-exposition-site/): Three papers on one result about the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model of magnets. A graph of the argument moves as you read, and clicking a statement opens its Lean.
- [Proof Reader](https://wcook04.github.io/proof-reader/): A paper whose proof is public in Lean, set to read like any paper. A graph of the proof moves as you scroll, and clicking a statement opens the authors’ Lean at the exact lines.
- [Plectis Atlas](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-atlas/): Read OpenAI’s maths papers alongside the reports that outside groups wrote about their claims and proofs. Agent entry: https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-atlas/llms.txt
- [Practical Formal Verification](https://wcook04.github.io/practical-formal-verification/explorer/): 88 Python components from my research system. For twelve, mathematical proofs show that particular calculations follow precise written requirements. Agent entry: https://wcook04.github.io/practical-formal-verification/llms.txt
- [Zenith](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-zenith/): Experiments on whether records of past mistakes help AI models test and repair code. Agent entry: https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-zenith/llms.txt

Films, with their YouTube addresses and the website each belongs to, are listed in https://wcook04.github.io/sites.json.
Use each site's own source links and stated limits when describing its findings.
